name: bounded-runtime-harness
description: Skills-only plugin that packages evaluation-first governance and a bounded runtime harness for ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Evaluation-first governance and fail-closed runtime skills
interface.longDescription: Install this plugin to load the governance skill and the bounded-runtime-harness skill. Governance writes evaluation-first markdown contracts. The harness skill compiles those contracts into proposal envelopes, inference gates, runtime gates, and forbidden-action tests. Layer 0 decoder constraints are best-effort on ChatGPT UI.
defaultPrompt: Scaffold evaluation-first governance files for this repository.
Compile existing .harness contracts into a bounded runtime controller with forbidden-action tests.
